starting-the-quest.speaker: Patzi
starting-the-quest.text: Good day! I don't suppose I could trouble you for the briefest of moments?

steps.player: I suppose I could consider being troubled for a little...

steps.speaker: Patzi

starting-the-quest.text: If the player meets the quest requirements:

steps.player: Good day to you! I could consider being troubled, for the right reasons.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: How does access to a rather fancy party sound as a motivator?

steps.player: Well, just as long as I get to actually enjo-

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: I'm sure I can also rustle up some payment to encourange you, if you have any reservations.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: You may even find some... exciting opportunities inside, given the presence of some of Aldarin's wealthiest citizens!

steps.player: So if you're going to this party, would you also be one of Aldarin's wealthiest citizens?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Alas, I am, quite unfortunately, not rich in money. What I do possess is a certain wealth...

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: ... of talent! For you see I am... an actor! Patzi the Grand, they'll call me... eventually.

steps.player: They call me [player name]... just [player name]. So if you're not rich in money, how am I going to get paid, assuming I agree to help you with... whatever it is you want.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Cutting words, but you need not worry. While you won't be getting paid upfront, I have a feeling that if all goes well, I will soon find myself with more than enough wealth to handsomely reward you.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: And besides, if nothing else, I'm sure you'll have a wonderful time at the party!

steps.prompt: Start the Death on the Isle quest?

steps.player: I suppose I could do with letting my hair down a little. Alright, I'm in.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Wonderful!

steps.player: So whose party are we going to?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Well, that's complicated...

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Sometimes a man has to follow his heart... and a second hand invitation saying there's a party at Villa Lucens tonight.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Yes! The villa is home to an almighty patron of the arts! He even has his own theatre atop the cliffs behind the villa! In fact, the whole reason for this party is because he's showing his new play!

steps.player: And yet you don't actually know who he is?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: This opportunity came about quite suddenly. As such, I'm unfortunately not as prepared as I otherwise would be. However, an actor like myself can't turn down the chance to meet with a man like him.

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Not to mention the chance to enjoy a good party.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Well said, Adala. Oh that reminds me, [player name], this is Adala. She's also helping me out today!

steps.player: If you have her, why do you need me?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: She advertised herself as a bag carrier, so she's here to move my bag around. There's a lot of costumes and props that I travel with, so it's nice to have someone else carry them.

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I'm not going to say no to going to a fancy party, even as the help.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: As for your part in all this, [player name], with this being a fancy party and all, I'm going to need a butler to help me fit in.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: You know, serving me wine and tending to my needs. Fancy suit and all?

steps.player: Right... So I don't actually get to enjoy the party at all, do I?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Oh I'm sure you will. You'll just have to act a little here and there!

steps.player: I see... You mentioned a fancy suit. You wouldn't happen to have a butler outfit in that bag you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: I don't believe I do. I don't really take roles like that these days.

steps.player: Well, in that case, any idea where I might get one, preferably free of charge?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Lots of the villas around here will have butlers, and butlers mean uniforms.

steps.player: Are you suggesting I steal one?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I suppose you could always put it back once you're done.

steps.player: And I'm sure whoever I take it from will be overjoyed to have had someone else wearing their uniform.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Hmm... Maybe I should add a butler's uniform to my vast array of costumes after all.

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I doubt they'll ever even realise. Anyway, I remember seeing some uniforms through a window on the way over here. They were in a villa to the north.

steps.player: Right... I guess I'm off to find a uniform then.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Good luck!

steps.player: I'm not really a party person these days, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Quite unfortunate. In that case, please make sure to keep an eye out for me at your local theatre. I'll be a star soon!

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-patzi-witho.text: Yes, I suppose so! Either way, Adala should be able to help you get your hands on one.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-witho.speaker: Adala

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-witho.player: Not quite. You said it was to the north of here?

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-witho.speaker: Adala
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-witho.text: I believe so. Once you get there, you should keep an eye out for any guards. Wouldn't want you to get arrested before the party starts!

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: I see you've  managed to find a uniform.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: I have indeed. You must have a good eye to have seen them  through a window as you walked by?

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Adala
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: It was a bit of a lucky spot, I must admit!

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: Lucky indeed. It's almost like you were specifically looking for them?

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Adala
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Just good fortune. Now, I ought to get a move on getting this bag inside.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Oh, she's in a rush, isn't she?

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: Given the size of your bag, I'm not sure she's rushing anywhere.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Well, she sets a good example. You should probably be heading on in yourself.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: I'm guessing the entrance is just up these stairs?

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: You'll have to go in through the staff entrance, unfortunately. I can't be seen entering with the help.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: You will have to use the staff entrance though.

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: Where would I find said entrance?

getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
getting-a-uniform-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: I'll bet Adala went through it. You should've followed her! I think she headed somewhere along that hedgerow.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: Oh yes, just give me a moment...
Hello there. I'm here to work.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: Not without a uniform you're not.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: Oh yes, just give me a moment...

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: Oh, nilsal, to you. I wasn't expecting anyone else.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: Sorry, there was a bit of a hold up. I'm quite new to this.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: A hold up? Nothing bad I hope? I've known people to have problems with their employers before. Is yours treating you well?

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: He seems... friendly enough. I'm still not sure if I'm getting paid though.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: Tetamo! Oh dear, oh dear. Are you part of a union?

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: I don't remember joining one. I probably should with the... varied working conditions I go through.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: We have a fantastic one here on Aldarin, if you're interested. I can't say discussions are effective, but sometimes the wealthy do come to the table!

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: I think this is a one-time gig for me, but thank you!

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: Very well. In that case, there are just a few quick admin bits to go through before I let you in.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: First and foremost, butlers must keep their uniforms and masks on at all times. If you are seen without yours, you will be ejected from the party.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: Got it. No taking off my uniform. What's this about masks?

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: All staff are to be as anonymous as possible tonight so we'll provide you with a mask on entry. We'll be using them to keep track of who's coming and going.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: Now, for security purposes, butlers are required to enter and leave with completely empty pockets. We'll hold on to anything you need us to whilst you're in there.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.player: Got it, nothing in and nothing out.

getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.speaker: Head Butler
getting-inside-the-villa-talking-to-the-.text: Right, I think that covers everything. Are you ready to enter?

steps.speaker: Head Butler

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi

If the player has not completed The Fremennik Isles:

steps.player: I feel like a court jester...

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.text: If the player has completed The Fremennik Isles:

steps.player: I feel like a court jester... and not for the first time either.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.text: Nonsense! Now, why not go and introduce yourself to our host and the other guests? I could do with knowing a little more about everyone.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.player: Hang on, I'm meant to be an anonymous butler. How do you expect me to get to know people for you?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.text: I'm sure you can get their names at least. That will give me something to work with.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.player: Okay... Anything else I can do for you, especially things you could easily do for yourself?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi.text: No, no. I think you're doing more than enough right now, thank you.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-tal.player: I haven't quite made my way around everyone the party yet.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: So, this is grand isn't it?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: It certainly seems to be quite the event.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: I'd say it's one of my finest yet, though I do wish more of the guests could've made it. However, it looks like we've gained a bit of a straggler.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: Yes, that slightly pompous fellow that hasn't introduced himself to anyone yet. The fact that he's here means he must have gained an invitation, though I don't know how...

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: Er... Is that going to be an issue?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: I'm sure it won't be! I'm always open to meeting new people, especially those who enjoy the arts.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: Oh good, because it's actually him who I'm here with. He was very keen to meet you, even though he didn't actually know your name...

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: I can't believe it! How could he not even know the name of his gracious host?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: Perhaps he's new to the island... Still, for an actor, his research seems lacking.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: He's an actor you say? Ah, now that explains why he was so eager to be here. Well, if he's good, this might be his lucky day. I, Constantinius, am in the market for a new actor to sponsor.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: Well, you know actors. Very profitable once they're popular. I like to... make investments.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: For example, I've sponsored tonight's lead actor, Livius, for some time. He's done very well for himself, and for me, though he's almost too expensive for me these days.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: Anyway, perhaps you'll see him tonight on stage!

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: So, Constantinius, how often do you put on these parties?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: Whenever we have a new play to unveil! I've got a couple of creatives from Tempestus that can write up a storm, so I find myself hosting these events more and more!

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: How does one usually get themselves invited?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: Normally we just send the invitations out to all the villas on the island! If you can afford one, then you're welcome here.

steps.player: Well, I'm actually wealthy enough to be a homeowner myself, but not on Aldarin unfortunately.

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: You must try to change that before next time. After all, the more the merrier.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: If the player owns a player-owned house that is also on Aldarin:

steps.player: Well, I actually own a home here on the island. Perhaps I can be invited next time!

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: Perhaps so. After all, the more the merrier.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: If the player doesn't own a house:

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.player: And you're definitely okay with me and my... we'll call him my employer, I guess. You're definitely okay with us being here?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-constanti.text: Well, we sadly had a few who couldn't attend this time, so I'm actually quite glad you're here. Still, I wouldn't mind knowing how your employer managed to acquire an invitation...

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.text: Sir? I thought I'd left that behind when I retired. Please, call me Cozyac.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.player: Absolutely, Cozyac. You can call me...

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.text: I seem to remember one of the rules of this party was that the staff were to remain anonymous.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.player: You can't call me then. Are you enjoying the party?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac.text: I am, yes. Though I am far more excited for tonight's performance. Constantinius says he's hired some of the finest actors for this one!

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac-ta.speaker: Cozyac
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac-ta.text: Absolutely! Though I'm starting to feel myself in need of another drink. I don't suppose you could sort that when you have a moment?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-cozyac-ta.player: I can certainly look into it.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo.player: Hi there. How can I be of service?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo.text: I could do with... another drink.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo.player: Do you have a preference? Wine, or something non- alcoholic?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo.text: Alcoholic? I'll have you know that I, Pavo, am most certainly not an alcoholic. Now scram.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo-agai.speaker: Pavo
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo-agai.text: Did you get that drink I asked for?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo-agai.player: You sent me away before telling me what drink you actually wanted.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo-agai.speaker: Pavo
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-pavo-agai.text: That's my mistake. I'll take some wine... Preferably a barrel of it.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.text: Nilsal to you as well. You seem different to the other staff here. First time?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.player: It is. How could you tell?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.text: You see similar things on boats. People look a bit wobbly until they settle.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.player: Oh, I hadn't noticed I was...
So do you spend a lot of time on boats?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.text: I run something of a shipping company. If you need it moving, Xocotla's Got Ya!

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla.player: Well, I don't typically find myself in need of that sort of thing, but if that ever changes, I'll keep you in mind.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.speaker: Xocotla
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.text: I'd have preferred not to talk about work, but I suppose you do seem friendly enough.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.player: What sort of things can you move?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.speaker: Xocotla
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.text: We can securely move pretty much anything. Animals, valuables, bulk cargo.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.speaker: Xocotla
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-xocotla-a.text: Swiftness and discretion are valuable to us, if you catch my drift.

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-enter-.player: I have no reason to go down there right now.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.text: I saw you make your way around the party! So then, who's who?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.player: Pavo, the drunk one over there. I'm not sure there's much to them other than their love of drinking.
Xocotla, who seems a lot more relaxed. It seems that she runs a shipping business.
Last of all for the guests we have Cozyac. He's quite up on the rules of this party, so he might not be happy that you weren't properly invited.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.text: Pfft, invited? I have an invitation and I can act like I belong here! He'll never know!

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.player: He might not, but our host Constantinius does.
Luckily, he didn't actually seem to mind you being here too much. Apparently he's actually looking for a new actor to sponsor.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.text: Sponsoring... me? How marvellous! Oh I think I should have a drink to celebrate! Could you be a dear and go into the wine cellar for me?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.player: What would you like from the wine cellar? A beer?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.text: Whilst that sounds lovely, I've heard there's some Principum Red down there! It's not produced any more so is rather hard to find, but our generous host seems happy enough to share.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aft.player: Alright, one glass of wine coming right up.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aga.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aga.text: Did you manage to find that wine yet?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aga.player: I haven't had a chance to even go into the cellar yet. You'll have to give me a moment.

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aga.speaker: Patzi
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-patzi-aga.text: Remember, you're looking for Principum Red. I'm sure it will be labelled.

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-climb-.player: I shouldn't go too far from the party for now.

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-open-t.player: 'Cupboard, keep out!' Why does it say keep out?

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-climb-.player: I shouldn't return to the party empty handed.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-an.player: Hmm... The label's faded, but I'm sure this is the wine Patzi was talking about.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-an.text: You're suddenly startled by the sound of a glass shattering in another part of the cellar, causing you to spill some of the wine on yourself.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-an.player: What... Oh, that's going to stain isn't it...

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-invest.player: I think it's probably best if I don't mess around with this again.

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-climb-.player: I guess I shouldn't leave without investigating that noise.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Is everything okay?
Hello?
Have you had too much to drink?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: You there! Don't move!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: What the...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: You're coming with us.
Player is transported to a small room on the ground floor of the villa.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: It's always the butler, isn't it.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Now now, Stradius. We don't know for sure they did it. It looks likely though.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Did what exactly?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Murder!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Stradius!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: What?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: It was my turn to level the accusation at a suspect...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: How often do we get to handle a murder?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: You have to respect the systems we have, Stradius!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I'm still here, in case you forgot?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: So, murder. Interesting choice at a party full of wealthy people, wouldn't you say?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Poor Livius... He wasn't acting this time.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: But I didn't kill anyone?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: You just happened to be found standing in a closed room with a dead body?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: With bloodstains on your clothes, no less.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Bloodstains?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: The red stains on your uniform. The victim's blood, I'm sure of it.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: You found me in a wine cellar and you won't even consider that it might be wine?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: I suppose I could try tasting it...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Stradius! What if it's blood?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Well, then it won't taste like wine, will it?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: No, you make a good point actually.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I'm just going to go...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Oh no you won't! You're going to wait right there and answer some questions!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Would you believe me if I said I didn't do it?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: We'll consider it.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: We will?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: But first, questions! Why were you down in that cellar?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I was looking for a wine. Principum Red? Patzi sent me to get some for him to drink. I just happened to hear a commotion and thought someone may have been hurt.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: So you were just trying to help?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Yes!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Honestly, I'm sold.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Stradius...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Ah, yes, sorry...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: I'm afraid we can't just let you go. Not without an investigation.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Not to mention, given our whole job here was to stop anything bad happening at this party, we're not really doing so well right now. We'll look even more ineffective if we don't have a suspect...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Could be a career ender, really.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Quite.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Okay... Well, much like I didn't kill that man, I suppose I don't want to hurt your careers. Maybe I could catch the killer!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Do you have any relevant qualifications?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Wait... are we meant to have...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: After all, training to be a butler must have taken a long time.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: But I'm not even a butler! I got hired to act like one!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Right, now I have to put murder back on the table! Who are you?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I'm just [player name]. I got hired by Patzi to be a butler for this evening, alongside a lady called Adala.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Adala? Do we know an Adala?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Yes, I believe she's accounted for.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: You ran into her?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: She came in shortly after we arrested you. Your friend, Patzi, mentioned she'd been sorting out some of his costumes.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: You mean she was only accounted for after the murder took place?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Why do I get the feeling we're not doing a good job of actually investigating this?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: It isn't just you.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Again, maybe I could be an extra pair of hands here.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Have a potential suspect investigate the murder? It wouldn't be orthodox, but it might work...

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: I'm not sure I like the implication that we can't solve it ourselves.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: I agree, but we're not actually very qualified for this. We normally just guard drunk people, not solve murders!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: You make a fair point, Hutza.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: [player name], if you promise not to leave, can you help us work out what's happened here?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: I... promise not to flee the scene?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Perfect! Shall we get to investigating then?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Where should I start?

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: The victim was Livius, the lead actor in tonight's play. His body is still down in the cellar, so you should probably go and inspect it, along with the rest of the crime scene.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: No doubt you'll also want to question everyone. We'll keep them busy for you until you're ready. We'll also give you a case file to track your notes in!

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.player: Okay, let's get to it.

inside-villa-lucens-investigating-the-ma.text: Player is transported outside of the room.

inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-open-t.speaker: Hutza
inside-villa-lucens-attempting-to-open-t.text: And where do you think you're going?

inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-hutza-or-.speaker: Stradius
inside-villa-lucens-talking-to-hutza-or-.text: I'm afraid we can't just let you go. Not without an investigation.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Could you give me any tips for this investigation?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You'll want to have a look down in the wine cellar I imagine. We made sure that nobody went down there after we arrested you, so everything should be as it was when the murder occurred.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You'll probably also want to do a bit of questioning up here as well.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Are you going to help with any of this?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: We'll keep an eye on everyone for you.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: What if the actual murderer is still in the cellar somewhere?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: We'll come looking for you if you're gone too long. It's not like there's anywhere for them to escape to!

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You will probably be dead by then though...

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: On the bright side, it would prove your innocence.

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Oh, this is exciting isn't it!

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: I got arrested for murder because you sent me into that cellar!

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Did you at least manage to find what I sent you down there for?

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: The Principum Red? Of course. Constantinius has a nice large container of it. However, I'm not sure if that's the most...

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Adala
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: What self-respecting man would have a wine cellar without such a historic wine in it?

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: It's a shame we're locked down up here. I'd love to try it! I came so close too, if it weren't for that actor...

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.player: Are you blaming Livius for his own murder?

the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.speaker: Patzi
the-investigation-talking-to-adala-or-pa.text: Of course not! I'm just ruing a missed chance to try that wine...

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.speaker: Constantinius
the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.text: Oh poor Livius! Where am I to find another actor of his calibre?

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.player: Was he by any chance the one you mentioned earlier? The one who was starting to get too expensive for you?

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.speaker: Constantinius
the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.text: I may have had some quibbles with how expensive his performances were, but he always made a profit!

the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.speaker: Constantinius
the-investigation-talking-to-constantini.text: I can only hope his understudy is capable of filling the gap that's going to be left. Livius always kept her in the shadows, though he did say that she was nearly ready for a leading role of her own...

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.player: You didn't happen to know Livius, did you Cozyac?

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.text: I'm familiar with his work, but not the man himself. He's been Constantinius' preferred actor for a few years now.

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.player: Did he ever come and join the parties? Perhaps you crossed paths during the festivities?

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.text: I'm almost certain we didn't. The actors spend the entire party getting ready, and then I usually fall asleep by the end of the play!

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.player: The plays are that good are they?

the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-investigation-talking-to-cozyac.text: I'm an older man. I need a good early night to keep myself going. I am partial to a puzzle though, so solving this crime could keep me up all night!

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: You know, it's a surprisingly sobering moment when someone's murdered beneath your feet.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: We were once drinking fellows. The things I've seen him drink without even breaking a sweat...

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: Did you drink with him today?

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: I don't remember... It seems likely that I would've though. He never liked to prepare for a performance without at least a small drink.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: Assuming you did, where would you have had a drink with him?

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: Probably down in the cellar. That was always where he preferred to go.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: So you admit that you may well have been down there with him today. Do you think something might've happened whilst you were drinking?

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: I'd like to think that I would remember something so terrible happening in front of my eyes.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.player: And yet you can't actually remember if you'd been drinking with him.

the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-investigation-talking-to-pavo.text: Oh, that's a good point... In that case, I don't know...

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: Quite an unfortunate turn of events, isn't it?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: I'm not sure it's unfortunate so much as a tragedy surely?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: Well, I believe the play was actually intended to be a comedy. I'm hopeful they have an understudy who can fill in for today.

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: The play's still going ahead? Are we just going to ignore that a man was murdered?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: I'd rather not think about it, personally.

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: Okay... So Livius wasn't a customer of yours then?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: Would he have reason to have been?

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.player: Actors seem to have a lot of costumes to move around the place. Maybe a shipping magnate such as yourself would make good money off of them.

the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-investigation-talking-to-xocotla.text: I'm afraid I can't help you there. Good tip about the actors though. I'll have to visit the College of Bards next time I'm in Tempestus.

the-investigation-investigating-the-anti.player: I think it's probably best if I don't mess around with this again.

the-investigation-investigating-small-bo.player: It appears to be a box full of blank wine labels. I suppose they like to keep things well organised.

the-investigation-investigating-wine-sto.player: It's only half full. Someone must've been drinking from it.

the-investigation-investigating-jug.player: I wonder why this jug's been tucked away in the corner... Was someone trying to hide it?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: How's your investigation going?

steps.text: You mean more of them might be fake like you?

steps.text: It seems we're back to square one again, [player name], unless you can think of anything else to investigate?
