the-investigation-inspecting-threatening.text: The letter is from Cozyac to Livius. It describes an outstanding debt.

the-investigation-inspecting-shipping-co.text: The contract is between Livius and Xocotla. It's for the shipping of an undescribed object.

the-investigation-inspecting-wine-labels.text: It's a set of labels for marking wine jugs. They look very similar to the ones on the jugs in Constantinius' cellar.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: I've had a little look through some pockets. I think all of the guests might be lying.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: All of them?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Well, maybe not Pavo. They just had this old drinking flask. Xocotla and Cozyac on the other hand both had things on them that revealed they had direct dealings with Livius.
Here, have a look at what I found for yourselves.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You hand over the note, contract, flask and labels.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Interesting... What about these labels?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: She was the one who wasn't accounted for when the murder took place, right?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: That's right. She's the one who came here with Patzi. Like [player name] here, both were uninvited.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Perhaps one of them is responsible... or indeed both of them.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: It's possible I suppose, but Patzi doesn't seem capable of pulling this off.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: It seems we still don't have anything conclusive. What do you think we should do?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: We could get them all together. Put pressure on them with some accusations and see who breaks?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Stradius
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: You think that'll work?

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.player: Only one way to find out I suppose.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: It's not the worst thought, and I guess whatever happens, there's a good chance that some more of the truth will come out.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: Alright, [player name], just let us know when you want everyone gathered and we'll take them upstairs for you.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Perfect! Let's get everyone upstairs!
Player is transported to the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}.

options.text: I want to review the evidence a bit more.

steps.player: I want to review the evidence a bit more.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Good idea. Just let us know when you're ready.

the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.speaker: Hutza
the-investigation-talking-to-hutza-or-st.text: So what are these labels you found?

the-accusation-talking-to-hutza.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-talking-to-hutza.text: You take the lead here, [player name]. We'll be on hand to support you where needed.

the-accusation-talking-to-stradius.speaker: Stradius
the-accusation-talking-to-stradius.text: This bit's all up to you, [player name].

the-accusation-constantinius.player: Constantinius, you knew Livius well, didn't you?

the-accusation-constantinius.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-constantinius.text: I'd sponsored him for years, yes.

the-accusation-constantinius.player: How was that sponsorship working out for you?

the-accusation-constantinius.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-constantinius.text: Well, I can't say I wasn't profiting from it. Although I do admit that he'd become a little... excessive with his spending in recent times.

the-accusation-constantinius.player: So you'd almost benefit from him being out of the way, letting you find someone new to sponsor?

the-accusation-constantinius.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-constantinius.text: The thought has crossed my mind, but he was still profitable, and it's not like I couldn't just sponsor a second actor in addition to him anyway.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Constantinius! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. He was getting too expensive to sponsor and you needed him gone!

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: I wasn't tied to him... If I'd wanted to stop sponsoring him, I'd have just done that. There would have been no need to kill him...

steps.player: Well, perhaps you felt a murder mystery would have helped make this party interesting and memorable.

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: I can't deny that it has very much enhanced the event, but do you think I'd have someone killed just for a social function?

steps.player: That's... a fair point, and indeed, why would you kill your lead actor right before the play?

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: You're the one accusing me, [player name]. You should know.

the-accusation-talking-to-constantinius-.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-talking-to-constantinius-.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-constantinius-.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-cozyac.player: Cozyac, did you not claim to have never interacted with Livius?

the-accusation-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-accusation-cozyac.text: I did, and I shall stand by that claim! Why are you the one making these accusations anyway? You were the one down there with him! Besides, you're just a butler!

the-accusation-cozyac.player: A note written by yourself for Livius. Seems you weren't very happy with him...
So it seems you did know him. In fact, you had an issue with him, did you not?

the-accusation-cozyac.speaker: Cozyac
the-accusation-cozyac.text: Not one I would have killed him over! He owed me some money and wasn't paying up. I just needed to put some pressure on him.

the-accusation-cozyac.player: Hmm... An outstanding debt could be considered motive for murder...

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Cozyac! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. He owed you a debt and was refusing to pay!

steps.speaker: Cozyac
steps.text: Why? Why kill someone over a debt? A dead man can't repay me, so I'd have needed to actually reclaim the money before killing him, at which point I'd have no reason to kill him anyway!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: He makes a fair point, [player name].

the-accusation-talking-to-cozyac-afterwa.speaker: Cozyac
the-accusation-talking-to-cozyac-afterwa.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-cozyac-afterwa.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-pavo.player: Pavo, you and Livius were drinking partners, weren't you?
How heavily would you say you drank together?

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: On occasion, a little too heavily.

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: We'd tend to bring our own, although I did sometimes let him have a bit extra from my flask.

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: Yes, that's the one! I must've misplaced it.

the-accusation-pavo.player: If you were letting Livius drink from your flask, it wouldn't have been hard for you to poison him, would it?

the-accusation-pavo.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-pavo.text: But why would I poison a friend?

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Pavo! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You poisoned him when you let him drink from your flask!

steps.speaker: Pavo
steps.text: I would never do something like that! You have no proof!

steps.player: Well, the flask does still have some liquid left in it. Perhaps we should have it tested?

steps.speaker: Pavo
steps.text: Wait, there's still some left?
Pavo grabs the drinking flask from Stradius and quickly downs the rest of the contents.

steps.player: Oh... Well, I guess it's not poison then. Thanks for... helping to sort that one.

the-accusation-talking-to-pavo-afterward.speaker: Pavo
the-accusation-talking-to-pavo-afterward.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-pavo-afterward.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-xocotla.player: Xocotla, you've never had any dealings with Livius, have you?
So he's never needed anything shipped by your company? Nothing he needed to move swiftly and discretely?

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: Why would he? I'm sure he's got more than enough solutions for moving his costumes around.

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: That looks like a contract between... myself and Livius.

the-accusation-xocotla.player: Good eye. Interesting how you yourself seemed to not be aware of it, especially given it was you who was carrying it.

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: Alright, fine. Livius had recently contracted us to help him move some of his belongings around. He's been doing well for himself and was moving into a larger property.

the-accusation-xocotla.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-xocotla.text: I needed him to sign off on a slight change in timelines, and given we were both here, I thought we may as well get it sorted.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Xocotla! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You pretended you didn't know him, but you lied!

steps.speaker: Xocotla
steps.text: Yes... It may surprise you to know that I didn't want to be associated with a murder victim whilst an investigation was ongoing!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: I suppose that is fair, [player name], and lying isn't a crime on its own.

the-accusation-talking-to-xocotla-afterw.speaker: Xocotla
the-accusation-talking-to-xocotla-afterw.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

the-accusation-talking-to-xocotla-afterw.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Patzi, Adala. The two of you weren't even invited to this party...
But being here presented a huge opportunity for an up-and-coming actor like Patzi.
You already knew that Constantinius was thinking about sponsoring a new actor. Perhaps you decided to speed things along a bit by removing the competition.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Patzi
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: But why would I need to remove the competition if he was already open to sponsoring me anyway? That doesn't make sense...

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Perhaps, and indeed it is true that you couldn't have been present at the time of the murder. You never left the party. In fact you sent me down into the cellar for you, didn't you?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: So you're saying that you're actually more likely to be guilty yourself?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Sending me down there made me look guilty! A perfect way of drawing attention away from the true culprit.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: But... that would be a terrible plan. You were here with us...

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Which leads me on to you, Adala. Patzi was accounted for when the murder took place, but you were not. Care to tell us what you were up to?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: I took Patzi's bag to the backstage area, spent some time chatting to the actors, and then made my way to the party.

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: So you never entered the wine cellar?
But you knew a lot about it, didn't you?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: Where are you going with this?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.player: Wine labels from Constantinius' cellar, found on your person. Care to explain?

the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.speaker: Adala
the-accusation-adala-and-patzi.text: I just found them on the floor. It's bad manners not to pick up litter.

steps.text: If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Patzi! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You wanted him out of the way so you could take his place!

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: But why? Constantinius was open to sponsoring me anyway. I didn't need to kill anyone...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: I think he's right, [player name]. There's no real motive here.
If the player has not questioned others yet:

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
If the player has questioned others:

steps.player: Adala! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. All the evidence is pointing at you!
You were the only person missing at the time of the murder, and despite your claims, we have clear evidence you were in that cellar!

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Alright, fine. I admit I was in the cellar.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Wait, what is this?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: The Principum Red, you fool. I could retire on the value of that wine. All I had to do was get out of here with it.

steps.speaker: Constantinius
steps.text: My wine!

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: You used me...

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: And I probably would've got away with it too, if it wasn't for this precocious butler turned investigator you hired!

steps.player: What happened Adala? Did Livius interrupt your plan? Did he need to be silenced?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Murder! What a ridiculous assertion! I may be a thief, but I'd never kill someone!
Adala starts attacking the player.

steps.speaker: Patzi
steps.text: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?

steps.player: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: If the player loses the fight to Adala:

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I could've killed you, but I'm not that kind of person, just like how I didn't kill Livius.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: If the player wins the fight against Adala:

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: Stop! You're too good for me! You win!

steps.player: Are you ready to confess now?

steps.speaker: Adala
steps.text: I promise I didn't do it! I'm just a thief! I wasn't even strong enough to defeat you. How could I have killed Livius?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Stradius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: She may be telling the truth, [player name], but either way, we know she's a criminal now.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Come with us, Adala. You can have fun contemplating your crimes from your new cell...

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Does this mean we can get on with tonight's play?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.player: You still want to go ahead with the play? You don't even have a lead actor anymore!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Yes, it is a bit of a last minute issue, but I have no doubt that Livius' understudy will be able to step up.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.player: But Adala might not have even been the killer!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Well, you've been doing a wonderful job so far, so I'm sure if the villain is still loose, you'll catch them.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Constantinius, with respect, I'm not sure we can let everyone leave until we're sure we have this case solved.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: That's not a problem. You can easily keep everyone in the theatre. The only place they'd be able to run to from there is straight off the cliff!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: It's settled then! We will proceed with the play! While we do that, if the killer is still at large, the ever capable [player name] here will ensure they are dealt with!

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Oh, no, you can't come with us. I don't want your investigation disrupting things. You'll need to stay out of sight. Why don't you take the back way?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Constantinius
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: Yes! It's not been used in a while, so it's a little bit precarious these days, but I'm sure you'll manage.

the-accusation-fighting-adala.player: Fine. Where do I find this back way?

the-accusation-fighting-adala.speaker: Hutza
the-accusation-fighting-adala.text: The pathway leads around the cliffs to the south. We'll see you at the theatre, [player name].
The others depart for the theatre.

the-backstage-attempting-to-climb-up-the.player: I don't think I should be going up there.

the-backstage-attempting-to-enter-throug.player: I have no reason to go down there right now.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Well... we don't really have one, but the play is about to start and we still might have a killer on the loose.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.player: Perhaps there's some evidence we missed somewhere.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: It seemed like you'd been quite thorough. The only place you didn't check was here at the theatre.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.player: Well then I guess it's time to fix that.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: The stairs over there lead down to the backstage area. That's where the actors, including Livius, were getting ready for the play. That seems like the best place to check for any missing clues.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Any luck down in the backstage area?

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Keep at it! I'm sure you can solve this one!

the-backstage-searching-the-crate-before.text: You search the crate, but don't find anything of interest.

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.speaker: Costumer
the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.text: Nilsal. Are you the one who's trying to find Livius' killer?

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.player: That's right. So I'm guessing down here is your domain?

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.speaker: Costumer
the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.text: If you think I have any actual control in here, you'd be sorely mistaken. I don't think anyone could keep these actors in line. They're a... dramatic bunch.

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.player: Speaking of which, where are they?

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.speaker: Costumer
the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.text: The play will be starting as we speak. They'll all be up in the theatre.

the-backstage-talking-to-costumer.player: Right, well in that case, I'd better get to it. I'd like to have a look around down here. Hopefully I can find some sort of clue as to how Livius died.
I'd also like to ask you a few questions, if that's okay?

options.text: What can you tell me about the actors?

steps.player: What can you tell me about the actors?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: There's four of them in total... Well... was four I should say.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: There's Naiatli. She was Livius' understudy. After what happened, she's now taking the lead role tonight.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Then you have Clodius. He's getting close to retirement now so prefers to take on small, but impactful roles.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Finally there's Quintilia. She's quite new, so she mostly takes on the non-speaking parts.

steps.player: And all of them were in here earlier?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: That's right. Livius went out for his pre-performance drink, as he likes to do. The others all stayed here until after the murder happened.

steps.player: And you're sure none of them could have slipped out at any point?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: I don't think so. I suppose I do get quite engrossed in my work sometimes, so it's not impossible. But I'm sure I'd have spotted someone going up the stairs...

options.text: What's the crate of poison for?
options.condition: If the player has searched the crate of poison:

steps.player: What's the crate of poison for?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Ah, that was a gift from Constantinius. We were having a bit of a rat problem, so he gave us the poison to deal with them.

options.text: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.
options.condition: If the player has searched the costume rack:

steps.player: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: A stain?

steps.player: Yes, a wine stain. Apparently the costume belongs to Naiatli. Is there any reason the costume would be stained?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: No, none of her characters have any interaction with wine...

steps.player: Do you have any wine backstage?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: Well, the actors do often like to have a drink after a play, but I always ask that they do that outside so as to not risk any damage to the costumes.

options.text: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?
options.condition: If the player has searched the bookshelf:

steps.player: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: A passage? I had no idea, but I suppose it's not too suprising.

steps.speaker: Costumer
steps.text: This is an old villa. Apparently it once played a role in some smuggling operations a long time ago. I could see them having a few secrets to help them with that.

options.text: I'm going to get looking around.

steps.player: I'm going to keep looking around.

options.text: What can you tell me about the actors?
What's the crate of poison for?
options.condition: If the player has searched the crate of poison:

options.text: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.
options.condition: If the player has searched the costume rack:

options.text: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?
options.condition: If the player has searched the bookshelf:

options.text: I'm going to get looking around.

the-backstage-searching-the-costume-rack.text: You search the costume rack and find that one of the costumes has a wine stain on it. The label reads: 'Naiatli'.

the-backstage-searching-the-crate-after-.text: You search the crate and find it to be full of poison.

the-backstage-searching-the-bookshelf.text: The bookshelf hides a secret passage into the wine cellar.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: The play is well underway and for all we know there's still a killer out there. I hope you have something for us, [player name].

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.player: I think I might. It turns out there's a secret passage from the backstage area into the wine cellar. Someone could have got in and out without anyone else knowing.
Not only that, but the backstage area has had a rat problem recently. They have plenty of poison for dealing with them. That same poison could easily have been used to kill Livius.

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Hutza
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: But did you find anything that could tell us who did it?

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: Yes, we need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: But how? We established that he couldn't have accessed the cellar.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: That's right. The secret passage doesn't change that either as he never left the villa.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: So it was her? But why?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Adala may be a criminal, but she had no reason to want Livius dead. I don't think it was her.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: How would he have gained from killing Livius?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Exactly. If he's wanted to stop sponsoring him, he could have just done that. No killing needed.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Because of the debt? That could be a motive, but he never had the means.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: She did lie about knowing him, but we never determined any proper motive.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I don't think she ever had the opportunity either.

steps.player: I think you're right actually. Ignore me.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I thought we'd ruled them out?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Do you have new information that changes that, [player name]?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Well then it's probably not them.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The understudy that's on stage right now? Why?

steps.player: As a fellow actor, she had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar where Livius was having his pre- performance drink.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: But how did she kill him?

steps.player: The rat poison. Enough of that would easily kill a man. She poisoned his drink so that she could be back out of the cellar before he died.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I suppose that makes sense, but she wasn't the only one who had access to that passage.

steps.player: But she was the only one who had wine on her clothes. Wine isn't allowed backstage, so it must have come from the cellar.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Oh, very good! But what about motive?

steps.player: Constantinius mentioned earlier that she had been in Livius' shadow for some time. Killing him has finally allowed her to take on a leading role.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: I suppose this does all make sense, but are you certain?

steps.player: I'd say eighty, maybe ninety percent sure.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Well I suppose that will have to be enough. You've not taken us down too many wrong paths today...

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Except for the whole fake butler act.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: True, but you were honest about that pretty quickly. We'll wait until the play is over and then we'll take her in.

steps.player: Wait? But should we not be acting now?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Constantinius would kill us if we stopped the performance.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: And then we'd have another murder mystery on our hands...

steps.player: Well then we'll have to just speed things along a bit. I'm going out there!

steps.text: Player is transported to the stage.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The actor? But why would he do that?

steps.player: Well, he was one of the few who had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar. He also had access to the rat poison.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: But what was his motive?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: We're going to need more than that, [player name].

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The actress? But why?

steps.player: She had access to both the secret passage into the wine cellar and to the rat poison.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: But she doesn't have a motive... She also isn't the only one who had access to the passage and poison.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Really?

steps.player: Well, she had access to the secret passage. She claimed not to know about it, but she did know about the history of the villa. She also had access to the rat poison.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: But why would she kill him? What's the motive?

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Sounds like she might not be our killer then, [player name].

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: You think Livius killed himself?

steps.player: Well it's the last thing anyone would expect.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: It's the last thing anyone would expect because it obviously didn't happen! Let's try considering some more plausible candidates.

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Us? But surely we'd remember...

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Of course it wasn't us! Stop messing around, [player name]!

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: You?! Goodness, it's the crime of the century! Right, come with us!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Stop playing around, [player name]! We have a killer to deal with!

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: The dog? But how would a dog do something like this?

steps.speaker: Stradius
steps.text: Never underestimate a dog, Hutza.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Okay, but even if the dog did have the means, it didn't have the opportunity, not to mention motive...

options.text: I don't know yet. I need to review the evidence.

steps.player: I don't know yet. I need to review the evidence.

steps.speaker: Hutza
steps.text: Be quick, [player name].

the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.speaker: Stradius
the-backstage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradi.text: We need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?

steps.text: Player is transported to the backstage.

the-stage-talking-to-hutza-or-stradius.text: Player is transported to the stage.

the-stage-subsequently-talking-to-hutza-.player: I need go back on stage.

the-stage-subsequently-talking-to-hutza-.text: Player is transported to the stage.

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: At last, the vile villain shows themselves!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.player: Villain? The only villain here is you, murderer!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I am no murderer! What vexatious allegations you come at me with!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Cozyac
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I'm not sure about this new character. Are they even in costume?

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.player: Do not pretend you don't know! Your lies are at an end!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Constantinius
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I don't think this was in the original script...

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: I've overcome so much! I won't fall at this last hurdle!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.player: Lay down your arms! Your heroic deeds are fabrications!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: Player attacks Naiatli, resulting in her taking three damage.

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli.text: Argh! You're stronger than I thought... I need to regroup!

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.text: Ha! You've stepped into my trap.

the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.speaker: Clodius
the-stage-talking-to-naiatli-again.text: Aha, villain! This is where you fall!

the-stage-attacking-clodius.text: Player attacks Clodius, resulting in him taking five damage.

the-stage-attacking-clodius.speaker: Clodius
the-stage-attacking-clodius.text: I'm sorry... You'll have to fight alone.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli.text: How could you be this powerful?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.player: It's all part of my grand plan. I grow stronger with every passing moment!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.text: Player attacks Naiatli, resulting in her taking eight damage.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli.text: I can't keep up with this!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: I must make my last stand... Could you find it in your heart to stay your hand?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: And let you live to foil my plans another day? I'm afraid that's not the game we play!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: Player attacks Naiatli, resulting in her taking four damage. Naiatli falls on the stage.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: And so I take my leave from this mortal coil!

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Pavo
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: Well that was a twist, wasn't it?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Naiatli, I know you killed Livius. Why?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: I've been stuck in the shadow of that man for too long. He wouldn't even let me fill another role...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Murder is a bit far though. Could you not have just... lightly poisoned him?

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: You don't understand... I never poisoned him... I just tripped him. All I wanted was to put him out of action. A small injury would've been enough for him to not perform this evening...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Naiatli
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: He'd had so much to drink. He fell harder than expected, and he wouldn't get up... I fled... I never wanted him to...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Oh, Naiatli... Come on, let's get you to the guards.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: Player is transported inside the villa.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: Stradius, Hutza, it's been a surprising pleasure working with you to solve this case.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Stradius
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: I can't believe it was all an accident...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Hutza
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: [player name], you've done well. I'd like to apologise for our hasty arrest earlier. Your commitment to helping us has been commendable.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Stradius
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: To be fair to us, you did seem like the perfect suspect.

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.player: I suppose I did, but no harm done. I'm just glad we got it all sorted out, though I don't think Patzi is going to be paying me any time soon...

the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.speaker: Hutza
the-stage-attacking-naiatli-again.text: You win some and you lose some I guess. All the best, [player name]!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-hutza.speaker: Hutza
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-hutza.text: You were quite impressive up on stage. Maybe you should take up a career in acting... or investigating crime.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-stradius.speaker: Stradius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-stradius.text: Thanks for your help again, [player name]. It's good to know people like you are around.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.text: No thanks to you! This was meant to be a big moment for me, and you totally upstaged me!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.player: Are you angry at me for getting involved in all of this? Did you forget that it was you that hired me?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.speaker: Patzi
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.text: I hired you to make me look better!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-patzi.player: And I don't think I did too bad a job. You never got kicked out, even though you did bring a thief in with you.
So how about that payment you promised?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.text: Well, I never imagined you'd be quite the actor!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.player: I have to admit, I rather surprised myself there.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.text: I don't suppose you'd like to be acting here in the future? To be honest, I'd prefer you to that odd fellow that brought you to my door.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.player: It's a kind offer, but I'm afraid it was a one-time job.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.speaker: Constantinius
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-constanti.text: Anyway, do feel free to wander around the villa whenever you fancy. I don't recommend drinking from the wine fountain though.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.speaker: Costumer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.text: You were very brave for going on stage to confront a killer. Looks like you did well to get her to surrender without damaging her costume.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.player: It was very well made. Makes the job of not damaging it much easier!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.speaker: Costumer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.text: Why thank you! I credit my needles for the good work.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.player: Would I be able to get one of them for my own purposes?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.speaker: Costumer
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-costu.text: I suppose I could part with one... If you're careful not to lose it.
The costumer gives you one of her special needles.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: After all that, are you sure I can't convince you to join the union?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: Kuani! I'll need to run and grab my forms, but if you wait there just a moment...

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.player: I was going to ask if you had any spare equipment...
I may have a need to mask my identity again in the future... or perhaps carry a tray around.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: You're certain you don't want to join the union as well?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.speaker: Head Butler
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-the-head-.text: I see. In that case, which equipment would you like?

steps.text: The head butler hands you a ram mask.
The head butler hands you a wolf mask.
The head butler hands you a bird mask.
The head butler hands you a jaguar mask.
The head butler hands you a snake mask.
The head butler hands you a butler's tray.

steps.speaker: Head Butler
steps.text: Very well.

There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Constantinius' pocket.

post-quest-dialogue-opening-the-chest.text: You unlock the chest and find a note inside. It reads: 'Taken for a clean. Be back soon.'

post-quest-dialogue-searching-the-south-.text: You find an interesting looking icon in the fountain.

post-quest-dialogue-activating-the-aldar.text: You touch the statue, but it doesn't seem to do anything. Perhaps the icon you found might be of use.
